project.name: oriah-quote
project.description:
The payable quote and its digest (MVP_PLAN Phase 0, item 4.4): quote, then commit. Checkout's preview and order's placement must compute byte-identical digests over the same quote -- each line's variant, quantity, unit price and per-piece discount, the delivery option and its amount, the currency and the total -- so there is exactly one implementation, here, and both services use it. Two copies would drift, and then every confirm would answer 409.
Only the JDK and oriah-money (the ngwee rule) on the classpath, so depending on it cannot change either service's wiring.
